text:
Keyboard shortcuts

This page follows the Shortcuts picker in the sidebar. Switch it and the whole page changes, including which shortcuts exist at all — the two apps don't have identical sets.

Anything listed in Settings → Shortcuts can be rebound. Menu commands and editor shortcuts are fixed.

Unbound by default

Two things ship without a key so they cannot shadow a shortcut you already use. Bind either in Settings → Shortcuts.

Lift element — expands the focused note, terminal, or portal into a centered panel. Double-clicking its header does the same.
Align and distribute — eight actions for lining up a multi-element selection.
